description: Completed a structured, project-based DevOps internship focused on Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud infrastructure, observability and CI/CD. Built and deployed end-to-end infrastructure solutions using AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Prometheus and Grafana while developing strong troubleshooting, documentation and technical ownership skills.

Developed platform engineering solutions to improve developer productivity and internal tooling. Delivered Python-based GitHub monitoring systems, maintained Terraform modules with automated testing and validation, and created GitHub Actions workflows to automate documentation publishing to Confluence.

Designed and implemented automation solutions across the employee lifecycle. Built an onboarding and offboarding platform using Azure Lifecycle Workflows, Logic Apps, Runbooks, PowerShell and Python, helping reduce SLA breaches and improving operational efficiency across IT services.

Provided first-line IT support while driving automation initiatives. Led Intune migrations for over 100 devices, coordinated a 1TB SharePoint migration and developed Python and PowerShell automation scripts that reduced manual effort and improved operational efficiency.

Provided first-line software support, troubleshooting customer issues and assisting users with business-critical software applications while developing strong problem-solving and customer service skills.
Supported end users across a range of hardware, software and business systems, resolving technical issues and contributing to day-to-day IT operations within a fast-paced environment.

Completed an intensive IT training program covering core networking, systems administration, technical support and industry best practices, providing the foundation for a career in IT and platform engineering.
